description: Frictionless Table Schema of Platform/01-store/forms/write-checks.probes.tsv (ADR-0125 addenda (12), (13); OBSH.39.3). Every field is a raw string: no type coercion. Constraints only where the header of the form or the existing check states them; CEL, JSON, owner, typed, numeric and prose-agreement rules stay with the existing checks (raw map of the change 0125-forms-table-schema-p01).

fields.name: n
fields.description: A row n of write-checks.tsv, 0 for pass; no foreign key: 0 is no row, and the evaluation stays with the existing check.

fields.name: sock
fields.description: A role of the #allow lines of the header; checked by the existing check.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The JSON of the body; JSON and the outcome stay with the existing check.
